title: Anchor
description: An act that stays with a person regardless of the autonomy level of the rest of the process. Legal anchors cover legally binding acts; strategic anchors cover direction. An anchor halts the run at a step boundary and raises a decision request. Every organisation defines its own set; the set can be reduced but never emptied. The decider is a role, never a named person. See docs/architecture/governance.md and ADR-0008.

act.description: The act kept with a person, in one sentence: payment release above 10,000 EUR; accepting or rejecting a feature.

applies_to.description: What triggers the anchor. At least one selector.

risk_classes.description: Risk classes as the organisation names them.

scope.description: Where the anchor holds. Absent means everywhere in the tenant.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, optionally with a subdivision.

role.description: The role that decides. The person is resolved at runtime.
